description: 香美町_町民バス停留所 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 香美町. 香美町の町民バスの停留所名、読み方、緯度・経度のデータ. Coverage: 香美町. The portal files it under the publisher 香美町. Its tags are バス停, 位置情報, 公共施設, 地図. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2021-02-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
